item.jaymoskingdoms.soul_scythe.desc: Made of five hundred souls. It reaps all who stand beside the one it strikes, and what it kills banks twice.
item.jaymoskingdoms.zenith_axe.desc: A nether star is forged into it. In the hand of one who holds the Sun's arts, the ascension has a fifth step.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.dru_green.desc: The Wild key, out of a shape. Tap at a foe: ivy roots it where it stands. Tap at a friend: a vine gives them your health. Tap at a block: the vine hauls you to it. Sneak and tap at a foe: the vine drains it into you. Under the open sky by day you slowly mend, and fire hurts you half again as much.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.dru_bloom.desc: The Wild key, out of a shape. Sneak and tap with no foe in sight: a patch of sunflowers at your feet heals your side, twice as fast in the day's sun. Sprint and tap at a friend (or at no one, for yourself): a cocoon of roots closes over them. Nothing harms them, they can't move, and they mend.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.dru_sizes.desc: The Wild key. In a shape, tap grows you a size and sneak and tap shrinks you. Out of a shape, hold the key with no creature in sight to shrink, sneak and hold to grow; until you are your own size again the key works as it does in a shape. Each rank opens one more size each way, a speck to a colossus. Small, use a bigger creature to ride it unnoticed. Big, sprint and tap stomps, and holding the key grabs a smaller creature (hold again to throw it). Shedding a shape sheds the size.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.dru_ray.desc: The Wild key, out of a shape. Hold it at a creature: a ray shrinks it a size. Sneak and hold: the ray grows it. It wears off in a minute. A creature you have shrunk as far as it goes can be put in a glass bottle, and let out again where you use the jar.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.cle_sun.desc: The Sun key. Tap: a sun orb. Sneak and tap: a pillar of sunfire. Sprint and tap at a foe near you: pin and pummel. Hold: a sun of your own to fight by. Fighting climbs four steps of ascension, growing as you go. All of it is stronger the higher the sun stands. Only the Crowned Sun's sworn can learn it or use it.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.pal_sun.desc: The Sun key. Tap: a sun orb. Sneak and tap: a pillar of sunfire. Sprint and tap at a foe near you: pin and pummel. Hold: a sun of your own to fight by. Fighting climbs four steps of ascension, growing as you go. All of it is stronger the higher the sun stands. Only the Crowned Sun's sworn can learn it or use it.
